evidence.text: "Today we celebrate the thousands of children who are alive because of the historic Dobbs decision, which corrected the Court’s unconstitutional ruling 49 years earlier in Roe v. Wade. There is still a lot more work to do to protect the right to life, especially with President Biden’s Administration being one of the most pro-abortion in the history of our nation. I will never stop fighting for the right to life and a nation where every life is valued."

positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?

evidence.text: "America’s current financial path is unsustainable. We must course correct by cutting spending, reducing the size and scope of government, and increasing revenue through growth — not tax increases. We must put America on a sustainable path. It is not an option."
"Here’s what’s in House Republicans’ Limit, Save, Grow Act—one of the largest cuts to federal spending in our nation’s history."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: "Biden’s addiction to deficit spending has made housing unaffordable for many Americans due to skyrocketing interest rates. Yet his budget requests nearly $50 billion in "free money" for mortgages. This will only make housing even more unaffordable."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "All of us are feeling the devastating impact of inflation. The inflation crisis in America is the direct result of the Democrats’ interference in the economy. By artificially pumping trillions into the economy, career politicians are destroying the buying power of those they intended to help. The remedy for inflation is to stop government’s runaway spending."

"Our nation has been headed down a path to fiscal ruin because of repeated congressional decisions to live beyond our means. Inflation continues because the Washington establishment is incapable of saying "no" to heightened spending."

evidence.text: "The Biden Administration is moving forward with its plan to cancel $39 billion in student loan debt for 804,000 borrowers. This is a massive giveaway to elites and is an unconstitutional use of executive power."
